verdict.rationale: OpenHands is model-agnostic and lets users configure an agent's model through settings, which is manual selection, not automatic routing. The closest evidence is `ask_oracle`, which lets an agent consult a stronger or more specialized model for a second opinion, but it explicitly does not switch the active model. That makes it only a glancing, adjacent capability rather than per-prompt routing. Missing for 10: automatic per-task model routing or selection, routing criteria or policy configuration, documentation of a router feature, and any hands-on corroboration.
